definition: A defined character, tone, or set of behavioral traits that a language model is instructed or trained to adopt during interactions.
details: Personas are commonly configured via system prompts or fine-tuning, shaping how a model communicates (formal vs. casual, concise vs. detailed) without necessarily changing its underlying knowledge or reasoning ability.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. Here is the short version: A defined character, tone, or set of behavioral traits that a language model is instructed or trained to adopt during interactions. The part that makes it sing: Personas are commonly configured via system prompts or fine-tuning, shaping how a model communicates (formal vs. casual, concise vs. detailed) without necessarily changing its underlying knowledge or reasoning ability. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Persona (in AI systems) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
